svg.title: Jing-Zhang Public Honor Landmarks, Annual Events and Conversion Pathway
svg.desc: Three public honor nodes, annual event rhythm, developer community, scenario opening and a conversion pathway from research to long-term urban adoption.
svg.text: Jing-Zhang City Completeness v0.5 | Public Honor Landmarks + Annual Events + Conversion Pathway
A landmark is not a sculpture list: it first performs a public function, then makes transparent and verifiable achievements worth a purposeful visit.
Three AI public honor / pilgrimage nodes

g.text: Place: Zhongzhiyuan | Primary function: controlled testing + public teach-back
Honor display: failures, stop reasons, safety improvements and retest evidence shown beside successes
Visitors learn how technology is constrained and when it should not be used, not only product demonstrations.
test boundary / human takeover / privacy / ordinary public route must pass first.
02 CITY COMMONS HALL｜城市公共客厅
Place: AI Origin Community | Primary function: resident daily use, service review and public discussion
Honor display: annual C7 improvements, resident questions, withdrawn/adjusted AI services and maintenance responsibility
“Honor” comes from public value and correctable governance, not a closed VIP room.
free core hours, no-account entry, accessibility and staffed service must continue.
Place: Dazhongsi/southern public interface | Primary: transfer, heritage, market/adoption window
Honor display: Jing-Zhang engineering history, AI-city experiment archive, global case comparisons and reusable public methods
Fixed Chinese/English interpretation is the floor; multilingual AI remains optional.
real station/transport, heritage and public-space conditions require professional verification.

svg.text: Annual event rhythm: every event creates evidence for the next design iteration

g.text: publish seven-capability gaps, unresolved data, public questions and last year's stop/rollback record
decide which problems deserve research/testing before choosing an AI technique
researchers, startups, public-service staff and residents frame problems, data boundaries and test plans together
candidates fail admission if IP, privacy, safety or exit conditions are missing
small-scope tests in the Open Test Yard or bounded nodes, with non-AI baseline and stop thresholds public
“validated and not continued” is an acceptable outcome
residents, professionals and operators review adopted/stopped scenarios and update the landmark archive
only evidence-rich scenarios with maintenance responsibility proceed to scaling discussion

svg.text: Developer community and scenario-open operations: from public problem to long-term adoption

g.text: residents, operators and professionals may propose
define data, risk and non-AI baseline
enters daily life but remains exit-ready
maintenance owner + KPI + annual review + non-AI baseline

svg.text: STOP is allowed at every stage: without reliable sources, authorization, data boundary, safety, public value or maintenance responsibility, nothing proceeds. “Do not deploy” is a valid result.

City Completeness Week / Open Test Yard / City Commons Hall / Jing-Zhang Civic Station are concept names for this submission only; real event brands, trademarks, sponsorship, organizer relationships and attraction/conversion mechanisms require separate authorization and confirmation.
Concept operations system only; not a government event plan, fiscal commitment, investment contract, official award or confirmed operator.
